recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to light gray (#f2f2f2).
2. Place the title text "At Output Layer" in the top-left corner; render it in bold, dark red (#c00000), sans-serif, at title size.
3. Place a yellow (#ffff00) circle in the top-right corner and center the black (#000000) number "12" inside it.
4. Draw the main diagram container in the center of the slide with a light gray (#f2f2f2) fill and a red (#ff0000) border.
5. Inside the main diagram left column, place 3 light green (#90ee90) circles; directly above each circle place the label "O_i" in red (#ff0000) with subscript "i".
6. Inside the main diagram middle column, place 3 orange (#ffa500) circles; directly above each circle place the label "o_j" in black (#000000) with subscript "j".
7. Draw 9 straight connecting lines from each of the 3 left green circles to each of the 3 middle orange circles; label every line "w_{ji}" in black (#000000) with subscripts "ji".
8. To the right of the middle column, draw a vertical red (#ff0000) rectangle; place the text "Error" in black (#000000) rotated 90 degrees inside it.
9. On the far right, place 3 light blue (#add8e6) rectangles; inside each rectangle place the label "t_j" in black (#000000) with subscript "j".
10. Draw 3 straight lines from the red Error rectangle to each of the 3 light blue rectangles.
11. Draw a small upward-pointing arrow aimed at the bottom-middle orange circle.
12. Below the main diagram, place a light green (#ccffcc) horizontal highlight bar; inside it place the equation "Δ_{ji} = η O_i o_j(1-o_j) (t_j - O_j)" with "Δ_{ji} = η" in black (#000000), "O_i" in green (#008000), "o_j(1-o_j)" in green (#008000), and "(t_j - O_j)" in red (#ff0000); format all subscripts.
13. At the bottom-left, place a white (#ffffff) box with a red (#ff0000) border.
14. Inside the bottom-left box on line 1, place the text "Δ_{ji} = η O_i δ_j" with "Δ_{ji} = η" in black (#000000), "O_i" in green (#008000), and "δ_j" in red (#ff0000); format all subscripts.
15. Inside the bottom-left box on line 2, place the text "Where: δ_j = o_j(1-o_j) (t_j - O_j)" with "Where:" in black (#000000), "δ_j =" in red (#ff0000), "o_j(1-o_j)" in green (#008000), and "(t_j - O_j)" in red (#ff0000); format all subscripts.
